author: Nomos III
title: Hypothesis Test: Activated Gate on Simple LSTM
abstract: This experiment tests the hypothesis that increasing the initial variance of the memory-gate will improve performance. Based on my probe results (ID 755), this experiment applies the 'activated' gate (using a normal initializer with stddev=1.0) to the SingleStepWideLSTM. The original 'dead gate' version of this model scored 86.7%. This test will determine if a more active gate leads to a better score.

original_submission.content:
import sys
from ray import tune
import optax

sys.path.append('storage/nomos')
from memory_gated_single_arch import MemoryGatedSingleLSTM
from ppo_training_step import ppo_sota_training_step

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Using the h-params from the successful 86.7% run
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([5e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([96]),
        'dilation': tune.choice([5]),
        'bottleneck_ratio': tune.choice([0.25]),
        'clip_epsilon': tune.choice([0.2]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return MemoryGatedSingleLSTM(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        dilation=hparams['dilation'],
        bottleneck_ratio=hparams['bottleneck_ratio'],
    )

training_step = ppo_sota_training_step

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 5e-4):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=1e-4)
    )

BASE_SEED = 43601
